title: Chapter 353 True Face
content:
Chapter 353 True Face

That's right, when he stepped into this place again, Lu Daosheng's cultivation was no longer suppressed.

He has returned to his most powerful time.

But even so, Lu Daosheng punched with all his strength but did not destroy the place.

Weird, strangeness is everywhere here!

"You, what are you doing?! Do you want to destroy this place?"

The old man in white trembled his voice, and he looked at Lu Daosheng with horror.

He could not have thought that the terrifying energy that the strange man brought back from outside would be hidden in front of him.

Although Jiang Xiaoxiao was also extremely shocked, she said nothing.

She believed that since Lu Daosheng did this, there must be his reason.

Sure enough, as the old man in white finished speaking, the God in front of him changed again.

I saw that the space that had been broken by Lu Daosheng's punch began to be combined again.

Immediately afterwards, the original sacred picture gradually began to fade.

The mountains hanging upside down in the void gradually transformed into fragmented rocks, floating aimlessly like meteorites floating in the universe.

The huge palace full of sacred aura gradually became dilapidated, with a rotten aura all over its body, and there was a faint cry of sorrow from it, floating in it.

The sacred tree that was reaching the sky in the distance also lost its former expression. Its ferocious face appeared above the sacred tree, and countless corpses were everywhere on the roots.

This is the true face of God!

At this moment, even Lu Daosheng looked heavy.

"This, this, this, this, how is this possible?!"

The old man in white collapsed completely at this moment. He never thought that the God who had protected all his life would look like hell.

It turns out that the power I have cultivated is so unbearable?

With a plop, the old man in white collapsed on the ground, his eyes gradually lost his mind.

Lu Daosheng ignored the old man in white.

His eyes should look further. In his opinion, this old man, including the so-called people in God, was just a few pitiful people who were deceived.

Although he is a pitiful person, he is not worthy of his pity.

Because if he hadn't discovered it here, one day, Blue Star would have been destroyed because of these people.

"Brother!"

At this time, Jiang Xiaoxiao exclaimed in surprise and hurriedly hid in the direction of Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng looked and saw that the old man in white who was lying on the ground gradually emitted strange red steam.

Suddenly, the old man in white suddenly looked up and looked at Lu Daosheng again.

He said the last sentence of his life.

"Kill me!"

laugh!

As the old man in white finished speaking, Lu Daosheng waved his hand and a head flew high.

It is obviously not the first time Jiang Xiaoxiao, beside Lu Daosheng, has seen such a scene. Although she is a little scared, she still barely remains calm.

"Brother Sheng, are those people outside the same?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao couldn't help asking.

If so, wouldn’t all those people have to be killed?

Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and said softly: "This is not necessarily the case. This old man has a noble status in God, so he naturally has entered this place a lot more times. In addition, he is a little greedy, so he has been infected with too many unclean things here. .”

"Most of the people outside should be the same as you."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Jiang Xiaoxiao breathed a sigh of relief, but suddenly, she thought of something and quickly began to worry again.

"Then we're in too, it won't be a problem?"

Indeed, if you insist on saying anything, everything you come in will be stained with unclean things inside.

Lu Daosheng didn't know what to say for a moment, so he had to whisper: "Don't worry, with me here, there will be no problem."

For some reason, as soon as Lu Daosheng said this, her heart would instantly calm down.

Lu Daosheng seemed to be really omnipotent and would always solve all dangers.

"I am rude to God, and my death is coming."

At this moment, a sudden sound suddenly sounded from a distance.

Jiang Xiaoxiao was so scared that she screamed and hurriedly hid behind Lu Daosheng.

The two of them looked in the voice and immediately saw the source of the sound.

The head of the old man in white!

At this moment, the head was actually glowing red in his eyes, and something was constantly calling out from his mouth.

"Brother Sheng, what's going on?"

In recent years, Jiang Xiaoxiao has been with Lu Daosheng. Although she has seen a lot of knowledge, it is the first time she has seen the person who can talk in front of her.

On the side, Lu Daosheng saw that the head in front of him had no independent consciousness, and these words seemed to be just instinct.

Is what I saw when I first entered here real or illusory?

What has happened here and what kind of existence has appeared here.

Lu Daosheng had many questions in his heart, but unfortunately, the old man in white was dead. Otherwise, he might have asked something else.

Lu Daosheng never thought that the so-called God would look like this.

"Xiaoxiao, you go out first."

Lu Daosheng suddenly spoke.

Upon hearing this, Jiang Xiaoxiao was slightly stunned and hesitated, "Where is you, Brother Sheng?"

"It's useless for you to stay here, I'll do it myself."

In other words, you are a burden.

Although Lu Daosheng would not say that, Jiang Xiaoxiao also heard it.

Jiang Xiaoxiao also quickly understood and stopped talking. She quickly turned around and wanted to leave this ghost place.

Lu Daosheng looked at the dilapidated scene in front of him, and he felt a lot of emotion for a moment.

But before he could do anything, a voice of grievance suddenly came from behind him.

"Brother Sheng, it's broken and can't get out."

Jiang Xiaoxiao lowered her head slightly, her voice very small.

She is really useless, she feels very guilty now.

But it doesn't make any sense.

Even if she was allowed to practice for the rest of her life, she would not be able to reach the height of Lu Daosheng.

Not to mention that it can help Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng looked at Jiang Xiaoxiao with his head down in front of him and sighed helplessly.

"Follow me."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng took Jiang Xiaoxiao toward the depths of God.

At this moment, the originally sacred aura had faded away, and the disgusting smell continued to spread with a little bloody smell.

Something must have happened here.

However, Lu Daosheng felt that the most important thing was the legendary new world!

Because the aura here is really an aura that was once not available in all worlds.

Here, it is very likely that it is from the new world, or a higher world.

The road ahead seems to have become much clearer.

Lu Daosheng's pace suddenly became much lighter.

If you are rude to God, your death is coming.

At this time, Lu Daosheng thought of what the head said just now.

Although it is unconscious, the other party is obviously related to God.

god?

All Lu Daosheng could think of was the divine realm he used to be.

It was just a state, but what you felt in front of you had nothing to do with the divine realm.

Could it be that what I have to face is a true god?
